description: BDRoad-Sense is a road-surface image benchmark collected across urban and rural Sylhet District in Bangladesh from November 2025 to February 2026. The Data in Brief article describes four smartphone cameras and five labelled classes: major damage, minor damage, normal road, manhole and speed breaker. Mendeley version 3 lists a large ZIP archive and metadata CSV under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is selected Sylhet District road imagery. The release is intended for road-condition detection and maintenance screening, not a complete map of pavement structural capacity or measured crash risk. Image selection, camera differences, class balance and the geographically limited survey are limitations when estimating network-wide degradation. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating a pavement-state observation component in a road maintenance or digital-twin simulation. data-openstreetmap is a related road-network resource, but this review did not link image locations to its edges. The eight-gigabyte image archive was not downloaded.
